page.layout: Two woodcut medallions with captions at the top, one per portrait, centred across the page. Below them one column of running text in four paragraphs. A decorative ornament at the foot, without text. No margin notes. Running head at top centre, page number at top right.

main_text.p: OTHONIEL filius Cenes,& frater Caleb minor natu, de tribu Iuda, iudicauit populum Israël anno mundi 2538. an-te Christum natum 1424. In eo fuit spiritus domini:egresfúsq; est ad pugnam,& tradidit dominus in manus eius Chusam-ra-sathiam Regem Syriæ, cui Israëlitæ seruierant annis octo, & oppressit eum. Hic iudicauit Israële quadraginta annis,& mor-tuus est. Iudicum 3. Iofe.antiq.lib.5.cap.7.
AXA filia Caleb fuit, atque uxor Othoniel. Hæc à viro præmonita petiit à patre agrum,ac obtinuit,Iudicum cap.1.

AOD qui & Ehud,filius fuit Gora[?],filij Iemini.hic Israelem iudicauit annos octuaginta à morte Othoniel:primus annorum huius principatus fuit 2578. à creato mundo:& ante Christum natum 1384. Hic populum liberauit à tyrannide Eglon regis Moabitarum,cui seruierat annos decem & octo, propter legis transgressionem.Iudi.3.Iofe.lib.antiq.5.cap.8.
SAMGAR,filius Anath,iudicauit populum post Aod annum unum.hic percussit de Philisthiim sexcētos viros vomere, alij legunt stimulo boum.Iudicum 3.

page.notes: The two medallion captions are printed inside the woodcuts; the right caption is split into two lines ("ACSAH FIL. CAL." and "VX. OTHO."). "Gora" in AOD's paragraph is uncertain at the scan resolution. Printed spelling kept throughout, including "Iofe", "Israële" and "Iemini". Faint show-through text in the lower margins and page edges was left out.
